title: 3.10.3 Individual PA Part 3: Write the Steps
description: Part 3 of 4, 30 points. One problem, pick one of three, write the JavaScript it describes: functions with parameters and returns, an array of records, map, spread, and a save/load round trip. Three tries with feedback on each criterion; no Run button.

aiGrader.rubricTitle: Chapter 3 Individual PA, Part 3: Write the Steps
aiGrader.prompt:
The student submitted one JavaScript program answering one of three Part 3 problems (Price Check, Reading Log, Watering Rota). Mark the CODE against the three criteria below. This is a summative item with three tries: mark what is on the paper for this try, do not ask the student to run it.

The Chapter 3 ceiling: no classes, no `this`, no constructors. The array methods taught are push and pop (3.3.2), map, slice, concat and spread only -- a program that uses filter, reduce, forEach or sort has gone past the chapter; credit any behaviour it produces, note the technique in feedback, and take the technique point from the criterion that needed it (the student met this in 3.7.19's named-but-not-taught list). Selecting a subset is taught as a loop and push (3.3.17); totalling is taught as a loop and an accumulator (3.3.12).

Criterion 1 -- the functions and their returns (12 of the 30; 6 for 3.1 definition/call, 6 for 3.2 parameters/return). At least two named function declarations, each called at least once, each returning a value with return. Full credit: the functions decompose the problem (one for the record/total, one for the comparison or the report), parameters carry what the body needs, and nothing does its whole job by printing. Partial: functions exist and are called but at least one prints instead of returning (6), or one function exists and the other job is done at top level (7). Withhold: no function, or functions declared and never called.

Criterion 2 -- the list and its objects (12 of the 30: 3 for the array of record objects, 3 for the loop that walks it, 3 for the map() call, 3 for the spread copy). An array of record objects, walked with a loop, with at least one map() call carrying an arrow function and at least one spread copy. Full credit 12: the array literal holds object literals with matching fields, a for/for...of loop walks it, map() produces one line per record, and spread appears in a copy. Partial ladder: 9 for the records, loop and map all present but no spread; 6 for an array of objects with a loop but no map and no spread; 3 for an array of plain values (not records). Withhold: no array of records.

Criterion 3 -- the save/load round trip (6 of the 30). The list (or the record) goes to localStorage with JSON.stringify under a key, and is read back with JSON.parse. Full credit: both directions present under one key. Partial 3: stringify without the parse-back, or parse without the save. Withhold: neither.

Also check, without changing the 30: the header comment names Problem and Date (Partners is N/A on an individual paper); the limit (budget, weekly goal or can size) is a const rather than a let, and is used in a comparison that is printed; at least one template-literal or concatenation console.log reports the result; typeof is reported for one value. Missing these are feedback lines, not point deductions -- the 30 points are the functions, the list and the round trip, and saying otherwise would re-weight the paper.

rubric.title: Named functions, called, returning values
rubric.description: Full credit 12: at least two function declarations, each called at least once, each returning with return; the decomposition matches the problem. Partial 6-7: functions exist but print instead of returning, or one job is done at top level. Withhold: no functions.

rubric.title: An array of records, walked; map() used; spread used
rubric.description: Full credit 12: array-of-objects literal (3), a loop over it (3), a map() with an arrow producing per-record lines (3), and a spread copy (3). Partial 9: records, loop and map present, spread missing. Partial 6: records walked by loop, no map and no spread. Partial 3: an array of plain values. Withhold: no array.

rubric.title: A save/load round trip through localStorage and JSON
rubric.description: Full credit 6: JSON.stringify into localStorage.setItem under a key, and JSON.parse of localStorage.getItem of that key. Partial 3: one direction only. Withhold: neither direction.
